items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: The interviewee confirms the location of a photograph as 'Tom Anderson's Canal and Ramport' and dates it to the 20s, but provides no personal interaction or relationship details.

ctx.x: We might confirm about this picture because, as I say, some people have tried to tell me that that was Peter Bocos or somebody else. No, that's my daddy. The picture, this is one taken to Tom Anderson's, is that right?
Paul Barbrin has a copy of the picture too. And we had borrowed one from Witten Joe Nicholas, the uncle of Albert Nicholas. And then this is Willie San Diego and Louis Russell, I believe, on piano.
